description: Add a published adventure to the signed-in member's bucket list or mark it as done, by slug (from search_adventures). Optional notes, completed_at (for done) and visibility (public, profile_only or private). Anything omitted keeps what is stored: visibility (public for a new entry), notes and the completion date. Repeating a call changes nothing. Requires sign-in.
name: mark_adventure
title: Mark an adventure
